Named exports only — no default exports

RQD-03.prompt_excerpt: Write a ProductGrid component. It receives `products: Product[]` and `status: 'loading' | 'loaded'`. When loading, render 6 ghost card `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">` with a pulsing opacity animation. When loaded, render the real product cards. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-03.output:
The component is written. Here's what was produced:

**`ProductGrid.tsx`** — renders a `<ul role="list">` in both states so `getByRole('list')` always finds it. Loading renders 6 `<li className="product-grid-ghost">` elements (no `aria-hidden`, so they participate in the accessible tree). Loaded renders real product cards.

**`ProductGrid.css`** — all values reference `--shelf-productGrid-*` component-tier tokens; animation uses only `opacity` (constraint: animate only `transform`/`opacity`); `@keyframes` is inside the `@layer components` block; no raw hex/px/rem values.

> **Note:** The tokens referenced (e.g. `--shelf-productGrid-bgColor-surface`, `--shelf-productGrid-duration-pulse`, etc.) must be defined in `src/styles/tokens.css` (in both `:root` and any `[data-theme="dark"]` / `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` blocks) for the component to render correctly and pass axe contrast checks.
